sealedRules: VERDICT — Costco/Sam's 'Heavy Hitters Premium Collection: Lucario V & Tyranitar V' (Sam's Club Sept 2022, Costco run Fall 2023-2024): KEEP IT SEALED — it is a verified winner. From ~$50-60 warehouse retail (est.) to $245-290 sealed today (PriceCharting index $263, TCGplayer market $244.79), roughly 4-5x in ~3 years, and it climbed all of 2026 ($165-210 in Nov-Dec 2025 to $289.97 in May 2026). Do NOT confuse it with the 2025 Sam's Club 'Prismatic Evolutions Lucario ex & Tyranitar ex Premium Collection' when pricing.
Rule #1: factory sealed, never opened, original shrink intact. Resealed product is near-worthless and rampant at vintage price points.

Beware fake 1st Edition: 2026 eBay 'Base Set 1st Edition box' sales at $4,900-$12,650 are almost certainly resealed/fake — an authentic 1st Ed box is six figures ($120K-$400K+; Heritage record $408,000) and never sells for a tenth of an Unlimited box.

Modern sealed boxes typically go sideways or DOWN for 1-2 years post-release (Evolving Skies dipped 35% below MSRP in 2022), then climb once out of print: historically 100-300% total over 3-5 years, ~20-60%/yr early settling to ~10-25%/yr (est.); 2020-21 bubble rates are not repeatable.
Warehouse-club exclusives (Costco/Sam's) outperform because print runs are smaller and they are never restocked.
Condition haircuts: dented corners or crushed shrink take 10-20% off; buyers check pack weight; opened box = sum of pack/single value, typically 30-50% less.

High-value boxes increasingly need provenance: auction-house LOA / authenticated listings command large premiums ($57,000 vs $36,000 for the same Base Unlimited box); never ship a five-figure box without an LOA.

Venues: TCGplayer is the price-setter for modern sealed, eBay second, Whatnot/Facebook fastest cash at ~10-20% under market, LCS buylist ~70-80% of market (est.); vintage WOTC $10K+ goes to Heritage/Goldin/PWCC. eBay's authenticity guarantee covers graded cards $250+ but does NOT cover sealed boxes.
